title: Kiritani Haruka — A Lavish Feast〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, thank you again for today.

rows.Speaker: Show Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you as well. We look forward to working with you ladies again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about a tough shoot. I still can't believe they had us dress up as ghosts for a haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I tried my best to scare the guests, but nothing I did ended up working...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... You did get lost for a bit while we were all getting into position...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And things got a little hectic after that when the guests realized who you were.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was pretty amazing to see so many of them flock to her like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She may not have succeeded in scaring them as a ghost, but she definitely gave them a good shock.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That defeats the whole purpose of our shoot!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, as unexpected as that was, she ended up fulfilling her duty as a ghost after that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I wish I had been scarier too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought I'd be able to do a better job since I'd done it once before during the school festival!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also wish I could've done a better job of scaring the guests.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That being said, a certain someone really stole the show today...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The way those guests screamed...
We could hear them all throughout the haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some of them were even crying a little after they exited...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I was so staggered.
How were you able to become such a convincing ghost?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
How...?
Remember how the regular cast did that demonstration for us? I just copied what they did.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You figured out how to be that scary just after watching their demonstration...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, how was she scarier than the actual cast...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You made such an adorable ghost, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's the point in being an adorable ghost?! How am I supposed to scare people like that?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We just gotta do better the next chance we get!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, please show us your ways!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? I mean...
I guess the main thing I did was try to get everyone to look my way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To look your way?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I noticed that the cast didn't really shout much when trying to scare the guests. Their goal seemed to be to very slowly draw their attention.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I tried to copy that, and...

rows.Speaker: Haunted House Guest A
rows.Line: I-Is it just me or is something following us...?!

rows.Speaker: Haunted House Guest B
rows.Line:
Whoa, don't say stuff like that!
Wait, huh...?! Y-You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No...on't...lea...ee...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't leave me...!!!

rows.Speaker: Haunted House Guests A & B
rows.Line: EEP!

rows.Speaker: Haunted House Guests A & B
rows.Line: AAARGH!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I started by getting them to notice the sound of my footsteps. Once they took notice and turned my way, I pounced and put all my energy into scaring them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I agree that it's better to build up some suspense first instead of just jumping out at them...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But you reproduced what the cast did to a T.
I didn't realize your work ethic extended to this kind of stuff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In any case, the crew were all saying how the guests gave them plenty of good reactions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
In the end, they got all the shots they needed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They said we should look forward to seeing it air. How do you think they're gonna edit everything?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Dunno, but I wouldn't be surprised if Haruka started getting offers for TV dramas and stuff considering how terrifying she was as a ghost.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: T-T-T-TV dramas?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not so sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if I do get that sort of opportunity, I might ask you to help me with my character, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As practice, I could follow you around and scare you from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-You're joking, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think we're all looking forward to seeing the show air.
